answer: Admission is a one-shot field burn, not a form. An applicant escrows 12.40 POA and receives one 26-stalk yarrow bundle tagged with a 19-byte lot (epoch seed mixed with a 33-bit ledge ticket posted 18 minutes earlier). In a 6-minute window they ignite it at a published canyon notch; two unaligned watchers snapshot the smoke plume at 80-second marks against a 1.6 m gauge and hash stills to the lot. Verifiers recompute hashes and reject a second bundle on that notch. Cost: 12.40 POA plus the live burn. A reused tag, stock still, or off-gauge plume slashes 71% and benches the notch for six epochs.
